content.short: Navi Protocol is the definitive lending and borrowing platform on Sui, offering modular DeFi, leverage vaults, and NAVX.
content.description: Navi Protocol is the definitive decentralized liquidity and money market platform built natively on the Sui blockchain. Designed for maximum capital efficiency and security, the protocol allows users to supply various digital assets to earn interest and borrow against them with sub-second finality. Navi leverages the high throughput and safety of Sui's Move programming language to provide a professional-grade borrowing experience, including specialized isolation markets for volatile assets and automated leverage vaults. Powered by the NAVX token, the protocol serves as a central hub for the Sui DeFi ecosystem, providing the essential liquidity infrastructure needed.
